title: Walsh character from the binary dot product
statement: For $\gamma,x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the vector Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ and evaluated at $x$ equals the binary sign character applied to the dot product $\sum_{i=1}^n\gamma_i x_i$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
